verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is community discussion of a JumpCloud security incident. One commenter says the vendor proactively rotated API keys, recommended rotating SSO certs, and 'handled the aftermath very well', which points to some responsive disclosure behavior. There is no first-party postmortem or trust page in the pack, so most of the story rests on a single secondhand account. Missing for 10: a published first-party incident postmortem, a live trust/security page, a documented disclosure history or security advisories archive, and independent corroboration of disclosure quality.
